name: Licensed hold-and-release / Job Reserve operating arrangement
cannot_activate_until: written regulatory confirmation that a non-redeemable, non-transferable, single-purpose grocery credit falls outside deposit-taking and payment-instrument regulation, stating what would take it back inside
grocery_rounds_position: NOT ENGAGED by Grocery Rounds under the Round credit model (25_GROCERY_ROUNDS/ROUND_CREDIT_MODEL_v1.md, Rev 2, 30 Aug 2026). A subscription buys credits that are not money, not redeemable in money and not transferable, so Dial holds an obligation to deliver groceries rather than a repayable sum. Rev 2 denominates credits in monetary value and defers the tax point to collection, which makes the credit multi-purpose and moves it closer to stored value: the closed loop is now the whole defence, not a discipline. Enforced by packages/round-credit rules RCM-001, RCM-002, RCM-015.

name: Zimbabwe fiscalisation and current tax treatment
development_mode: tax/fiscal adapter interface + versioned rules + simulator
cannot_activate_until: current VAT/IMTT/WHT rules loaded and independently checked
Zimbabwean tax counsel confirmation that a single-purpose grocery credit is taxed on issue, and what evidence of basket tax class ZIMRA expects at fiscalisation
grocery_rounds_position: Rev 2: Grocery Round credits are accounted for when the goods are collected, not when the credit is bought (ROUND_CREDIT_MODEL_v1.md §0, C3). That treats the credit as a multi-purpose voucher taxed on redemption, which is an exception to the usual earlier-of-invoice-or-payment time of supply and is the open question for counsel. It also makes every delivery a fiscalised, itemised sale per member — RCM-020 refuses a Round whose fiscalisation model does not match its tax point. Tax point is not revenue recognition: consideration for an unsettled credit is a contract liability until collection (RCM-008, RCM-010).

name: Dial Care insurance/benefit regulatory characterization
cannot_activate_until: IPEC/legal route confirmed for each product
protection-charge wording cleared so that disclosing what the price funds does not constitute selling the member a policy, and confirmation that no insurance intermediary registration is triggered
grocery_rounds_position: Rev 2 collects a protection charge on top of credit value (working figure 4%: 5,200 buys 5,000 of credit and 200 towards cover). Characterisation is the risk. Dial buys cover for Dial's own delivery obligation and discloses that a share of the price funds it; Dial must not collect an identified premium and arrange cover in which the member is the beneficiary, which would be insurance intermediation requiring IPEC registration Dial does not hold, and would contradict master plan §16.5. RCM-019 refuses a Round product that presents the charge as a member premium, and requires an indicative broker quote before tiers publish.
